 Bhuvneshwar Kumar to Daryl Mitchell, out Caught by Tilak Varma!! India have started well and they've their second wicket now - second catch of the night for Tilak Varma at cover - on a good length and it might've held up on the right-hander. Mitchell was shaping for the flick - he opened up his body and was through with the shot, but the ball caught the leading edge and popped behind cover-point. Tilak though had plenty of time to settle under and complete the catch. Replays show that it was a knuckle ball from Bhuvneshwar.
